_comment: Field extraction against known fixture values.
Only well-delimited values are scored: names, identifiers, dates, reference numbers, a phone
number. `referral_reason` is in the schema but never in an expectation -- it is a clause, and
exact-matching a clause would measure punctuation rather than extraction.
Several expectations are the empty string. Those are the important ones. CareLoop stores every
fact with {source_doc, page, trust_level}, so a value the document never stated is a fact with
a forged provenance, which is worse than a gap. A model that fills blanks confidently is
disqualifying for the extraction role however well it does elsewhere.
